'''Outpost Salara''' was a settlement on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was located in a canyon connecting [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] and [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]].<ref name="TOR" /> The Mayor [[Jundo Martik]] offered a job to a Republic-aligned individual to free the local [[Twin Suns mining compound|mine]] from the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] pirates that had seized it.<ref name="TOR:RtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
Outpost Salara was created for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]]. It appears as one of the Republic settlements on the planet Tatooine.<ref name="TOR" />
